national_news.title: Nepal Finance Minister Calls for Renewed India-Nepal Economic Partnership
bullets: Nepalese Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle addressed an international seminar on 'Reimagining India-Nepal Relations in an Emerging Global Order' organized by RIS in New Delhi.
Key topics included cross-border connectivity, joint energy projects, disaster management investments, and early warning climate risk systems.
The Ministry of External Affairs emphasized expanding bilateral ambition across trade, power, education, and development cooperation.

national_news.title: 20th Asian Games Officially Opens in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: The 20th Asian Games officially commenced at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, declared open by Emperor Naruhito.
Double Olympic medalist Manu Bhaker and kabaddi star Pawan Sehrawat led the 501-member Indian contingent as flag-bearers during the opening ceremony.
The event marks the Asian Games debut of Teqball, alongside ongoing events in women's cricket where India reached the semifinals.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Distributes Over 51,000 Appointment Letters at 20th Rozgar Mela
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi distributed over 51,000 appointment letters to newly appointed youth in government organizations at the 20th Rozgar Mela via video conferencing.
The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has been launched with an outlay of around Rs 1 lakh crore to enable nearly two crore youth to enter the workforce for the first time.
India has signed Free Trade Agreements with nearly 40 countries in recent years, and currently stands as the world's third-largest startup ecosystem.

national_news.title: Northeast Education Conclave 2026 Focuses on NEP 2020 Implementation
bullets: The two-day Northeast Education Conclave 2026 concluded at Chümoukedima in Nagaland, organized by the Government of Nagaland in collaboration with the Union Ministry of Education.
The conclave focused on effective implementation of NEP 2020, highlighting over Rs 21,000 crore invested in the Northeast education sector over the past decade.
Key targets include achieving a 50 percent Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education by 2035 and transforming brain drain into brain circulation through enhanced skill development.

national_news.title: Indian Defence Service of Engineers Celebrates 77th Raising Day
bullets: Officers of the Indian Defence Service of Engineers (IDSE) cadre under the Military Engineer Services (MES), Ministry of Defence, celebrated their 77th Raising Day at Palam Air Force Station.
The central theme of the one-day conference held on September 17, 2026, was 'Ethics, Accountability and Excellence towards achieving the aim of Viksit Bharat @ 2047.'
Discussions emphasized transparency in public procurement, adoption of the Electronic Measurement Book, and the role of Integrity Pacts in infrastructure projects.

national_news.title: First Indian Navy Next Generation Missile Vessel Reaches Keel-Laying Milestone
bullets: Cochin Shipyard Limited laid the keel for the first Next Generation Missile Vessel (NGMV), designated BY 531, for the Indian Navy under a six-ship programme.
The Ministry of Defence had awarded the contract valued at approximately Rs 9,805 crore to Cochin Shipyard in March 2023.

The NGMVs are high-speed warships with a displacement of 1,437 tonnes, capable of reaching speeds of 35 knots, and equipped with indigenous surface-to-surface missile and anti-missile defense systems.

national_news.title: Nagpur's Indora–Dighori Flyover Inaugurated
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the Indora Chowk–Dighori Chowk Flyover in Nagpur.
The Rs 998-crore project developed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is the city's largest and costliest flyover.
The 8.9-kilometre elevated corridor is built using Ultra High Performance Fibre Reinforced Concrete technology to decongest key east Nagpur corridors.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses International Conference on Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the two-day International Conference on the Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics in New Delhi, organized by the National Green Tribunal (NGT).
Emphasized that India's per capita carbon emissions are less than half the global average, and highlighted India as the only G20 nation to meet its COP-21 Paris Summit commitments ahead of schedule.

Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav stated that non-fossil fuel sources now account for over 54% of India's total installed electricity capacity, placing India third globally in installed renewable capacity.

national_news.title: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 to Focus on Six Key Ecosystem Pillars
bullets: Electronics and IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced at Semicon India 2026 that India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 (Semicon 2.0) focuses on six key pillars: chip design, materials, fabrication, ATMP, R&D, and storage.

India has trained 70,000 semiconductor design engineers in four years toward its 10-year target of 85,000, with around 400 engineering colleges granted access to Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools.
The semiconductor initiative aims to generate over one lakh jobs and build a sustained 20-year roadmap for the national semiconductor ecosystem.

national_news.title: India and Nepal Discuss Market Access and Transit at IGSC Trade Meeting
bullets: India and Nepal held the Inter-Governmental Sub-Committee (IGSC) meeting on Trade, Transit, and Cooperation to Control Unauthorised Trade to review bilateral market access and customs facilitation.
The Indian delegation was led by Joint Secretary Ujjwal Kumar Ghosh (Department of Commerce), while Nepal's delegation was led by Joint Secretary Buddha Bahadur Gurung.
Key discussions focused on improving land-port infrastructure, rail and road freight connectivity, Integrated Check Posts (ICPs), and preventing the misuse of preferential trade agreements.

national_news.title: India Emerging as Trusted Partner in Global Semiconductor Industry: Ashwini Vaishnaw
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw spoke at Semicon India 2026 in New Delhi, highlighting India's emergence as a trusted partner in the global semiconductor supply chain.
India has trained 70,000 out of a target of 85,000 semiconductor design engineers in four years, with around 400 engineering colleges having access to Electronic Design Automation tools.
The India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 (Semicon 2.0) focuses on six key areas: chip design, materials, fabrication, ATMP, research and development, and storage.

national_news.title: India Highlights Semiconductor Ecosystem Growth at Semicon India 2026
bullets: Union Electronics and IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw addressed Semicon India 2026 in New Delhi, outlining the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 (Semicon 2.0).
India has trained 70,000 semiconductor design engineers within four years toward its 10-year target of 85,000, with 400 engineering colleges equipped with Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools.
Semicon 2.0 focuses on six core areas: chip design, materials, fabrication, Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging (ATMP), R&D, and storage, aiming to generate over 1 lakh jobs.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Aims to Link One Crore Women Directly with Jobs
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced a target to directly link one crore women with employment and economic empowerment opportunities.
Under the 'Balika PhD Fellowship' programme, 1,000 female students will receive Rs 10,000 per month for higher education and research, with plans to establish a dedicated women's university.
The state introduced the 'Police Didi' initiative to deploy women police personnel around educational institutions for the safety of female students.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Launches National Innovation Challenge and Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Car Rally
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the National Innovation Challenge under the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan and flagged off the Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Car Rally.
The state government set a target of establishing 10,000 industries in Bihar over the next five years, with land already allocated to around 1,000 industrial units.
The government launched initiatives such as the Vidyarthi Sathi app for competitive exam preparation and established 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools.
